snippets.output: Singulair, also known as montelukast, is an oral tablet and not an inhaler.
snippets.pattern_notes: Enumeration of properties (formulation: oral tablet, not inhaler) for the same drug.

snippets.output: Singulair (montelukast) is commonly used for the management of asthma and allergic rhinitis.
snippets.pattern_notes: Enumeration of indications (asthma, allergic rhinitis) for the same drug.

snippets.output: Montelukast works by blocking leukotrienes, which are chemicals in the body that cause inflammation, bronchoconstriction, and mucus production.
snippets.pattern_notes: Mechanism causal chain: drug blocks leukotrienes which cause inflammation/bronchoconstriction/mucus production.
